title: What is real, mocked, and deferred
purpose: Make the demo contract explicit before showing it.
takeaway: Extraction, frozen scoring, validation, and OpenAI rewriting are real. Mock grades and deferred production features stay visible.

bullets: Real: source parsing, frozen P1 scoring, multi-query drafting, validation, review, and export.
Mocked: query alignment and answer clarity; the structural grade counts headings.
Deferred: persistence, live URL fetching, source-style rendering, HTML patching, calibrated graders, and GEPA.

speaker_notes: Say this before the demo so the audience knows what evidence each screen represents.
